Forwarding my findings after repro.

Summary: the promo issuance webhook from the PLG onboarding pipeline returned a 500 for the VOLTGIFT10 code at 2026-02-20T17:08:12Z (internal trace id 81723). The webhook retry logic attempted two subsequent deliveries but the token mapping job did not create the wallet transaction row. I attached the support log excerpt.

Next steps I recommend:
- Manually create the transaction row for Voltage Labs (I can run a one-off job).
- Add a short-lived requeue for any 5xxs in the issuance path to avoid silent drops.
- Patch the mapping codepath to validate idempotency of coupon application.

I’ll prepare the DB job and can apply the manual grant once Rishi confirms.

Attachments: support-log-81723.txt
